name: Pushblitz – Web Push Notifications
author: pushblitz

sections.description:
Enable push notifications on your WordPress site in 1-Click and start bringing visitors back instantly.

Pushblitz helps you capture your website visitors and re-engage them with real-time push notifications.

💡 What makes Pushblitz different?

• Native WordPress integration (send notifications directly from posts)
• Simple 1-Click setup
• Lightweight SDK with minimal performance impact
• Built for publishers and content-driven websites
• Developer-friendly API for advanced use cases

🚀 Why Pushblitz?

• Grow your audience even without email addresses
• Send notifications directly to user devices (desktop & mobile)
• Increase returning visitors and engagement
• Simple setup in under 1 minute

✨ Key Features

• One-click subscriber opt-in
• Send notifications directly from the WordPress post editor
• Real-time push notifications
• Audience segmentation
• Scheduled campaigns
• Detailed analytics dashboard
• GDPR-friendly

⚡ Perfect for

• News websites
• Blogs & magazines
• E-commerce stores
• SaaS platforms

💬 Example use cases:

• Notify readers instantly when you publish a new article
• Bring back visitors who haven’t returned in days
• Promote important updates or breaking news

Start growing your audience and bring visitors back today with Pushblitz

External services

This plugin relies on the external service Pushblitz API (api.pushblitz.com) for sending web push notifications.
The service is used to dispatch notifications to subscribers and retrieve statistics.
When a user registers for notifications, or when you send a notification, the site will securely transmit data such as notification title, body, icon, and optionally user segments (such as User ID or Role) if segmentation is enabled.
This service is provided by Pushblitz: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pushblitz directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Connect your site with 1-click registration or enter your API key
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills?

No. Pushblitz is designed for non-technical users.

Is Pushblitz free?

Pushblitz offers 14-day free trial to get you started with push notifications immediately. Paid plans start from $9/month.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, Pushblitz supports both web push notifications and mobile push notifications on Android and iOS devices.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, Pushblitz is designed with privacy in mind. You can easily delete all user data at any time.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The Pushblitz SDK is loaded asynchronously and served via a global CDN, ensuring blazing-fast performance without affecting your site speed.
